ko.title: 사이버 먼데이 카운트다운: 연말 연시 지출 전망이 말해주는 할인, 배송 및 반품

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: 블랙 프라이데이 주말이 마무리되면, 사람들의 관심은 그 뒤를 잇는 온라인 전용 쇼핑 데이인 사이버 먼데이로 쏠립니다.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: 소매 분석가들은 오랫동안 사이버 먼데이를 이커머스 업계에서 연중 가장 바쁜 날 중 하나로 꼽아왔습니다.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: 본 해설서에서는 업계 전망이 할인, 배송비 및 배송 마감일에 대해 일반적으로 무엇을 시사하는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: 또한 반품 정책에 따라 "특가 상품"의 실제 비용이 어떻게 달라질 수 있는지도 다룹니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Forecast figures vary by source and change over time, so check current reports and each retailer's own terms before you buy.*
segments.tr: 전망치는 출처에 따라 다르고 시간이 지나면서 변경될 수 있으므로 구매 전 최신 보고서와 각 소매업체의 자체 약관을 확인하세요.*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## 사이버 먼데이가 여전히 중요한 이유

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: 사이버 먼데이는 추수감사절 주말 직후 사람들의 온라인 쇼핑을 유도하기 위한 행사로 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: 오늘날 대부분의 대형 소매업체는 며칠 또는 몇 주 동안 온라인 프로모션을 진행하므로 단 하루라는 경계는 모호해졌습니다.

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 업계 추적 기관들은 이날의 온라인 지출액이 연중 최고 수준에 달한다고 자주 보고합니다.

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: 많은 예측가들 역시 전체 연말연시 소매 매출에서 온라인 매출이 차지하는 비중이 계속해서 커질 것으로 예상합니다.

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: 수치를 맥락에 맞게 이해하는 데 도움이 되는 두 가지 항목은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **전망치는 추정값입니다.** 무역 단체, 컨설팅 회사, 결제 데이터 기업은 "연말연시 쇼핑 시즌"에 대해 서로 다른 방법과 정의를 사용합니다. 따라서 이들의 총액과 성장률은 자주 차이를 보입니다.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **성장률과 절약 액수는 다릅니다.** 전체 온라인 지출이 증가할 것이라는 전망이 개별 상품의 할인 폭이 얼마나 클지까지 말해주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## 할인율에 대해 전망이 시사하는 바

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: 온라인 가격을 추적하는 분석가들은 가전제품, TV, 소형 가전, 일부 완구 등 몇몇 품목군에 가장 큰 가격 인하가 집중된다고 자주 보고합니다.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: 의류와 가정용품도 주로 할인 대상에 포함되지만, 상품마다 체감 절약 금액은 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 팁:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **할인율은 기준 가격이 정직할 때만 의미가 있습니다.** "40% 할인" 표시는 실제로는 거의 판매된 적 없는 권장소비자가격을 기준으로 책정되었을 수 있습니다. 최근 판매가와 비교하는 것이 훨씬 유용합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **가격 이력이 도움이 됩니다.** 가격 추적 도구나 장바구니에 저장해 둔 캡처 화면을 활용하면 해당 혜택이 신규 할인인지, 반복되는 할인인지 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **특가는 여러 날에 걸쳐 진행되는 경우가 많습니다.** 많은 소매업체가 이제 행사를 일찍 시작하고 반복해서 진행합니다. 특정 하루만 기다린다고 해서 반드시 더 나은 가격을 얻는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **한정 재고가 일반적입니다.** 가장 큰 폭의 할인은 소량의 재고에만 적용되는 경우가 많아 인기 상품은 날짜와 상관없이 매진될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## 배송비 및 추가 요금

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: 배송비는 좋은 특가 혜택을 상쇄시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: 전망과 소매업체의 발표에서는 다음과 같은 반복적인 패턴이 자주 지적됩니다.

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **무료 배송 기준액.** 많은 매장이 최소 주문 금액 이상 구매 시 일반 무료 배송을 제공합니다. 이 기준을 맞추려고 불필요한 지출을 했다가 할인 혜택을 상실하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **멤버십 프로그램.** 일부 소매업체는 유료 멤버십을 통해 배송 혜택을 제공합니다. 자주 쇼핑하는 고객에게는 유리하지만, 한두 번만 구매하는 경우에는 적합하지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **배송사 성수기 추가 요금.** 연말연시 동안 배송업체가 성수기 수수료를 부과할 수 있으며, 소매업체는 이를 명시적으로나 기본 가격 인상을 통해 고객에게 일부 전가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **대형 품목 및 도서 산간 지역.** 무겁거나 크기가 크거나 원거리로 배송되는 물품은 추가 비용이 드는 경우가 많으며, 무료 배송 대상에서 제외될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: 결제하기 전에 상품 가격, 배송비, 세금 및 수수료를 모두 합친 **총 최종 인도 비용(total landed cost)**을 비교하세요.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: 다른 경쟁 제안과 비교할 때 따져보아야 할 금액은 바로 이 총액입니다.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## 주의해야 할 배송 마감일

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: 구매하는 상품이 선물이라면 할인율보다 주문 마감 시간이 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: 소매업체와 배송사는 보통 12월 중순을 표준 배송의 마지막 권장 주문일로 안내하며, 유료 빠른 배송 옵션의 경우 이보다 늦은 날짜를 안내합니다.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: 이 날짜는 업체 및 지역에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 팁:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **결제 단계에서 예상 배송일을 확인하세요.** 상품 페이지뿐만 아니라 결제 화면의 날짜를 확인해야 합니다. 보장된 도착 날짜는 주소지와 선택한 배송 등급에 따라 달라지는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **"~까지 도착" 날짜가 보장된 날짜인지 확인하세요.** 일부 소매업체는 확정된 약속을 제공하는 반면, 어떤 곳은 추정일만 제공합니다.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **매장 픽업을 고려해 보세요.** 가능한 경우 온라인으로 구매하고 매장에서 수령하면 배송비와 배송 지연을 피할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **운송장 번호를 보관하세요.** 소포가 지연되거나 분실된 경우 주문 기록이 있으면 교환이나 환불을 요청하기가 쉬워집니다.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **분할 배송.** 단일 주문건이라도 여러 상자에 담겨 서로 다른 날짜에 도착할 수 있습니다. 특정 날짜까지 모든 상품이 필요하다면 각 품목의 예상 도착일을 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## 반품: 가격에 숨겨진 또 다른 절반

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: 상품을 반품하기 어렵다면 아무리 높은 할인도 가치가 떨어집니다.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: 연말연시 기간에는 반품 규정이 어떤 면에서는 더 엄격해지고 어떤 면에서는 더 관대해지기도 하므로, 구매 전에 반드시 읽어보세요.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: 확인해야 할 핵심 사항:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **반품 가능 기간.** 일부 소매업체는 연말연시 반품 기간을 1월까지 연장합니다. 다른 업체들은 단 몇 주에 불과한 평소의 기간을 유지합니다.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **반품 배송비 부담 주체.** 일부 매장에서는 무료 반품을 제공하지만, 수수료를 차감하거나 배송사에 직접 비용을 지불하도록 요구하는 곳도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **재입고 수수료(Restocking fee).** 특정 카테고리, 특히 전자기기의 경우 개봉 시 일정 비율의 수수료가 부과될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **최종 판매(Final-sale) 상품.** 큰 폭으로 할인되거나 재고 처분(클리어런스)되는 상품은 반품이 아예 불가능할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **환불 방식.** 일부 매장은 원래 결제 수단으로 환불해주지만, 경우에 따라 매장 크레딧(적립금)이나 교환만 제공하는 곳도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **상품 상태 규정.** 원래의 포장, 태그, 구성품이 그대로 있어야 하는 경우가 많습니다. 상품을 계속 소장할 것이 확실해질 때까지는 잘 보관하세요.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: 쉽게 생각해보면, $100짜리 제품을 30% 할인받아 샀더라도 반품 배송비가 $12 들고 15%의 재입고 수수료가 부과된다면, 구매를 실수했을 때 치러야 하는 실제 비용은 표시된 가격보다 훨씬 높아집니다.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: 무료이고 편리한 반품 정책을 제공하는 판매자의 약간 더 비싼 제품이 결과적으로 더 가성비가 좋을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## 결제 전 간단 체크리스트

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. 둘러보기 전에 예산과 필요한 품목 목록을 먼저 결정하세요.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. 단순 '이전 판매가'가 아닌 최근 가격 이력을 비교하세요.

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. 가격, 배송비, 세금 및 기타 수수료를 합산한 전체 비용을 계산하세요.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. 배송지 주소와 선택한 배송 옵션에 따른 도착 예정일을 확인하세요.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. 반품 가능 기간, 반품 배송비, 재입고 수수료 유무를 확인하세요.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. 구매자 보호 기능이 있는 결제 수단을 사용하고, 영수증과 확인 이메일을 보관하세요.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. 생소한 판매자나 요청하지 않은 메시지에 담긴 링크는 주의하세요. 사이트에 직접 접속하는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: 연말연시 이커머스 전망은 대체로 전체 시즌 지출에서 온라인이 차지하는 비중이 크고 계속 성장하고 있음을 가리키지만, 특정 혜택이 정말 좋은 제안인지는 말해주지 못합니다.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: 쇼핑의 실제 비용은 내가 실제로 지불하는 가격, 추가되는 배송비, 정시 도착 여부, 그리고 상품을 반품해야 할 때 발생하는 조건에 따라 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.

zh.title: 网络星期一倒计时：假日消费预测对折扣、配送和退货意味着什么

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: 黑色星期五周末结束后，人们的注意力便转向了随之而来的纯线上购物日：网络星期一（Cyber Monday）。

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: 零售分析师长期以来将其描述为电子商务一年中最繁忙的日子之一。

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: 本文旨在解读行业预测对折扣、运费和配送截止日期的普遍看法。

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: 它还涵盖了为什么退货政策会改变“便宜货”的实际成本。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供参考，不构成财务建议。

segments.src: Forecast figures vary by source and change over time, so check current reports and each retailer's own terms before you buy.*
segments.tr: 预测数据因来源而异，且会随时间变化，因此请在购买前查看最新报告和各零售商的条款。*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么网络星期一依然重要

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: 网络星期一最初是为了让人们在感恩节周末后进行在线购物。

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: 如今，大多数大型零售商会进行为期数天或数周的在线促销，因此“单日”这一标签的界限已经模糊。

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: 行业追踪机构通常仍报告称，当天的在线支出是一年中最高的支出之一。

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: 许多预测机构也预计在线销售额将继续在假日零售总额中占据更大的份额。

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: 两点有助于理解这些数字的背景：

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **预测只是估算。** 行业组织、咨询公司和支付数据公司对“假日季”使用不同的方法和定义。它们的总额和增长率往往各不相同。

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **增长不等于节省。** 预测在线总支出将上升，并不能说明任何单一折扣的力度会有多大。

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## 预测对折扣的建议

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: 追踪在线价格的分析师通常报告称，最大的降价集中在少数几个类别，例如消费电子产品、电视、小型家电和部分玩具。

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: 服装和家居用品通常也会打折，但不同商品的节省幅度可能有所不同。

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: 一些实用要点：

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **折扣百分比取决于起始价格。** “4折”标签可能是相对于该商品很少以其标价出售的价格来衡量的。与近期售价进行比较更有用。

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **价格历史记录有帮助。** 价格追踪工具和你自己保存的购物车截图可以显示交易是新的还是重复的。

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **优惠通常是分散的。** 许多零售商现在提前发布优惠并重复促销。等待某一天可能并不会让你获得更好的价格。

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **库存有限很常见。** 一些力度最大的折扣适用于少量库存，因此热门商品无论在哪一天都可能售罄。

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## 运费和附加费

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: 运费可能会抵消掉优惠。

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: 预测和零售商公告通常指出了一些反复出现的模式：

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **免运费门槛。** 许多商店提供超过最低订单金额的免费标准配送。为了达到门槛而额外消费，反而会失去节省的意义。

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **会员计划。** 一些零售商通过付费会员提供配送优惠。对于经常购物的人来说，这很划算，但如果你只买一两次，就不太合适了。

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **承运商附加费。** 快递公司可能会在假日期间增加旺季费用，零售商可能会通过公开方式或提高基础价格的方式将部分成本转嫁给客户。

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **超大件和偏远地址。** 沉重、笨重或远距离的配送通常成本更高，免运费优惠可能不包含这些情况。

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: 在结账前，请比较**总落地成本**：商品价格、运费、税费和任何手续费。

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: 这是与竞争对手的优惠进行权衡的数字。

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## 需要注意的配送截止日期

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: 如果商品是礼物，订单截止日期比折扣更重要。

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: 零售商和承运商通常会在12月中旬发布标准配送的最后建议下单日期，付费加急选项的日期会更晚。

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: 这些日期因公司和地区而异。

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: 一些建议：

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **在结账时阅读配送预估，** 而不仅仅是在产品页面上。承诺的到达日期通常取决于你的地址和配送等级。

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **检查“送达日期”是否为保证日期。** 一些零售商会做出明确承诺，而另一些则只提供预估。

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **考虑店内自提。** 在可行的情况下，在线购买并到店自取可以避免运费和承运商延误。

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **保留追踪号码。** 如果包裹延迟或丢失，订单记录可以让你更容易申请更换或退款。

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **拆分发货。** 单个订单可能会在不同日期分多个包裹送达。如果你需要在某一天前收到所有东西，请检查每件商品的预估时间。

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## 退货：价格中隐藏的一半

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: 如果商品难以退回，折扣的价值就会降低。

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: 退货规则在假日期间往往在某些方面变得更严格，而在另一些方面更宽松，因此请在购买前阅读它们。

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: 需要检查的关键事项：

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **退货窗口。** 一些零售商将假日退货期延长至1月。另一些则保持通常的窗口期，可能只有几周。

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **谁支付退货运费。** 免费退货在某些商店很常见，而另一些商店则会扣除费用或要求你支付给承运商。

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **重新入库费。** 某些类别，尤其是电子产品，如果商品已拆封，可能会收取一定比例的费用。

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **最终销售商品。** 折扣力度极大或清仓商品有时完全不可退货。

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **退款方式。** 一些商店退款至原始支付方式，而另一些在某些情况下只提供商店积分或换货。

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **条件规则。** 通常需要原始包装、标签和配件。在确定要保留商品之前，请妥善保管它们。

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: 一个简单的思考方式：如果一件100美元的商品有30%的折扣，但退货需要12美元并收取15%的重新入库费，那么错误购买的实际成本远高于标价所暗示的水平。

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: 从提供免费、简便退货服务的卖家那里购买价格稍高的商品，可能更划算。

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## 简短的结账前清单

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. 在浏览之前确定你的预算和需求清单。

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. 比较近期价格历史，而不仅仅是“原价”。

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. 加总全部成本：价格、运费、税费和手续费。

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. 确认你所在地址和所选配送选项的送达日期。

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. 阅读退货窗口、退货运费和任何重新入库费。

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. 使用提供购物保护的支付方式，并保留收据和确认邮件。

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. 对不熟悉的卖家和未经请求的消息中的链接保持谨慎。直接访问零售商的网站。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: 假日电子商务预测通常指出在线消费在季节性支出中所占份额巨大且在不断增长，但它们无法告诉你某项交易是否划算。

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: 购买的实际成本取决于你实际支付的价格、配送增加了多少费用、是否准时送达，以及如果需要退货会发生什么。

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: 在点击“购买”之前考虑所有这四点，是充分利用网络星期一最可靠的方法。

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## साइबर मंडे अभी भी क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: साइबर मंडे की शुरुआत थैंक्सगिविंग वीकेंड के बाद लोगों को ऑनलाइन खरीदारी के लिए प्रेरित करने के तरीके के रूप में हुई थी।

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: आज, अधिकांश बड़े रिटेलर दिनों या हफ्तों तक ऑनलाइन प्रमोशन चलाते हैं, इसलिए एक-दिन का लेबल धुंधला हो गया है।

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: उद्योग ट्रैकर्स अभी भी अक्सर रिपोर्ट करते हैं कि उस दिन ऑनलाइन खर्च साल के सबसे अधिक खर्चों में से एक होता है।

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: कई पूर्वानुमानकर्ता यह भी उम्मीद करते हैं कि ऑनलाइन बिक्री कुल हॉलिडे रिटेल का एक बड़ा हिस्सा लेती रहेगी।

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: दो बिंदु संख्याओं को संदर्भ में रखने में मदद करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **पूर्वानुमान अनुमान हैं।** व्यापार समूह, परामर्श फर्म और भुगतान-डेटा कंपनियां "हॉलिडे सीजन" के विभिन्न तरीकों और परिभाषाओं का उपयोग करती हैं। उनके कुल योग और विकास दर अक्सर भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **विकास का मतलब बचत नहीं है।** यह पूर्वानुमान कि कुल ऑनलाइन खर्च बढ़ेगा, इस बारे में बहुत कम बताता है कि कोई भी एकल छूट कितनी गहरी होगी।

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## छूट के बारे में पूर्वानुमान क्या सुझाव देते हैं

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: ऑनलाइन कीमतों को ट्रैक करने वाले विश्लेषक अक्सर रिपोर्ट करते हैं कि सबसे बड़ी छूट कुछ श्रेणियों में केंद्रित होती है, जैसे कि उपभोक्ता इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, टेलीविजन, छोटे उपकरण और कुछ खिलौने।

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: परिधान और घरेलू सामान पर भी आमतौर पर छूट दी जाती है, लेकिन बचत हर आइटम के लिए अलग दिख सकती है।

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक बिंदु:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **प्रतिशत छूट केवल शुरुआती कीमत जितनी ही अच्छी होती है।** "40% ऑफ" लेबल को उस लिस्ट प्राइस के मुकाबले मापा जा सकता है जिस पर आइटम शायद ही कभी बिका हो। हालिया बिक्री मूल्य के साथ तुलना करना अधिक उपयोगी है।

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **कीमत का इतिहास मदद करता है।** प्राइस-ट्रैकिंग टूल और आपके अपने सेव किए गए कार्ट स्क्रीनशॉट यह दिखा सकते हैं कि कोई सौदा नया है या बार-बार आने वाला है।

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **सौदे अक्सर फैले हुए होते हैं।** कई रिटेलर अब ऑफर जल्दी जारी करते हैं और उन्हें दोहराते हैं। किसी एक विशिष्ट दिन का इंतजार करने से आपको बेहतर कीमत नहीं मिल सकती है।

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **सीमित स्टॉक सामान्य है।** कुछ सबसे बड़ी छूट छोटे इन्वेंट्री पर लागू होती हैं, इसलिए एक लोकप्रिय आइटम किसी भी दिन बिक सकता है।

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## शिपिंग लागत और अधिभार

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: शिपिंग एक अच्छे सौदे को खत्म कर सकती है।

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: पूर्वानुमान और रिटेलर की घोषणाएं अक्सर कुछ आवर्ती पैटर्न की ओर इशारा करती हैं:

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **फ्री-शिपिंग सीमाएं।** कई स्टोर न्यूनतम ऑर्डर मूल्य से ऊपर मुफ्त मानक शिपिंग प्रदान करते हैं। सीमा तक पहुंचने के लिए अतिरिक्त खर्च करना और बचत खोना आसान है।

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **सदस्यता कार्यक्रम।** कुछ रिटेलर सशुल्क सदस्यता के माध्यम से शिपिंग लाभ प्रदान करते हैं। ये अक्सर खरीदारी करने वालों के लिए फायदेमंद हो सकते हैं, लेकिन यदि आप केवल एक या दो बार खरीदारी करते हैं तो ये उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **कैरियर अधिभार।** डिलीवरी कंपनियां हॉलिडे अवधि के लिए पीक-सीजन शुल्क जोड़ सकती हैं, और रिटेलर उस लागत का हिस्सा ग्राहकों पर डाल सकते हैं, या तो खुले तौर पर या उच्च आधार कीमतों के माध्यम से।

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **बड़े आकार की वस्तुएं और दूरस्थ पते।** भारी, बड़ी या दूर की डिलीवरी में अक्सर अधिक खर्च आता है, और मुफ्त-शिपिंग ऑफर उन्हें बाहर कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: चेक आउट करने से पहले, **कुल लैंडेड लागत** की तुलना करें: आइटम की कीमत, शिपिंग, कर और कोई भी हैंडलिंग शुल्क।

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: यह वह आंकड़ा है जिसे प्रतिस्पर्धी ऑफर के मुकाबले तौलना चाहिए।

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## डिलीवरी की समय सीमा पर ध्यान दें

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: यदि आइटम उपहार है तो ऑर्डर कटऑफ छूट से अधिक मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: रिटेलर और कैरियर आमतौर पर दिसंबर के मध्य में मानक डिलीवरी के लिए अपनी अंतिम अनुशंसित ऑर्डर तिथियां प्रकाशित करते हैं, जिसमें सशुल्क त्वरित विकल्पों के लिए बाद की तिथियां होती हैं।

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: ये तिथियां कंपनी और क्षेत्र के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: कुछ सुझाव:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **चेकआउट पर डिलीवरी का अनुमान पढ़ें,** न कि केवल उत्पाद पृष्ठ पर। वादा की गई आगमन तिथि अक्सर आपके पते और शिपिंग टियर पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **जांचें कि क्या "आगमन तिथि" की गारंटी है।** कुछ रिटेलर पक्का वादा करते हैं, और अन्य केवल एक अनुमान देते हैं।

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **स्टोर पिकअप पर विचार करें।** जहां उपलब्ध हो, ऑनलाइन खरीदना और स्टोर से कलेक्ट करना शिपिंग शुल्क और कैरियर की देरी से बच सकता है।

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **ट्रैकिंग नंबर रखें।** यदि कोई पैकेज देर से आता है या खो जाता है, तो ऑर्डर रिकॉर्ड रिप्लेसमेंट या रिफंड मांगना आसान बनाता है।

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **विभाजित शिपमेंट।** एक एकल ऑर्डर अलग-अलग तिथियों पर कई पैकेजों में आ सकता है। यदि आपको किसी निश्चित दिन तक सब कुछ चाहिए, तो प्रत्येक आइटम का अनुमान देखें।

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## रिटर्न: कीमत का छिपा हुआ आधा हिस्सा

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: यदि आइटम को वापस भेजना कठिन है तो छूट का मूल्य कम हो जाता है।

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: रिटर्न नियम अक्सर हॉलिडे अवधि में कुछ तरीकों से सख्त और अन्य में अधिक उदार हो जाते हैं, इसलिए खरीदारी करने से पहले उन्हें पढ़ें।

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: जांचने के लिए मुख्य चीजें:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **रिटर्न विंडो।** कुछ रिटेलर अपनी हॉलिडे रिटर्न अवधि को जनवरी तक बढ़ा देते हैं। अन्य सामान्य विंडो रखते हैं, जो केवल कुछ सप्ताह हो सकती है।

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **रिटर्न शिपिंग के लिए कौन भुगतान करता है।** कुछ स्टोर पर मुफ्त रिटर्न सामान्य है, जबकि अन्य शुल्क काटते हैं या आपको कैरियर को भुगतान करने की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **रीस्टॉकिंग शुल्क।** कुछ श्रेणियों, विशेष रूप से इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, में यदि आइटम खोला जाता है तो प्रतिशत शुल्क लग सकता है।

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **अंतिम-बिक्री आइटम।** भारी छूट वाले या क्लियरेंस सामान कभी-कभी बिल्कुल भी वापस नहीं किए जा सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **रिफंड विधि।** कुछ स्टोर मूल भुगतान विधि पर रिफंड करते हैं, और अन्य कुछ मामलों में केवल स्टोर क्रेडिट या एक्सचेंज प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **शर्त नियम।** मूल पैकेजिंग, टैग और एक्सेसरीज़ अक्सर आवश्यक होते हैं। उन्हें तब तक रखें जब तक आप सुनिश्चित न हों कि आप आइटम रख रहे हैं।

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: इसके बारे में सोचने का एक सरल तरीका: यदि $100 का आइटम 30% छूट पर है लेकिन वापस करने में $12 का खर्च आता है और 15% रीस्टॉकिंग शुल्क लगता है, तो गलत खरीदारी की वास्तविक लागत स्टिकर मूल्य के सुझाव से कहीं अधिक है।

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: मुफ्त, आसान रिटर्न वाले विक्रेता से थोड़ा महंगा आइटम बेहतर मूल्य हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## एक संक्षिप्त प्री-चेकआउट चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. ब्राउज़ करने से पहले अपना बजट और जरूरतों की सूची तय करें।

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. हालिया कीमत के इतिहास की तुलना करें, न कि केवल "थी" कीमत की।

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. पूरी लागत जोड़ें: कीमत, शिपिंग, कर और शुल्क।

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. अपने पते और आपके द्वारा चुने गए शिपिंग विकल्प के लिए डिलीवरी तिथि की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. रिटर्न विंडो, रिटर्न शिपिंग लागत और कोई भी रीस्टॉकिंग शुल्क पढ़ें।

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. ऐसी विधि से भुगतान करें जो खरीदारी सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है, और अपनी रसीदें और पुष्टिकरण ईमेल रखें।

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. अपरिचित विक्रेताओं और अवांछित संदेशों में लिंक के प्रति सावधान रहें। इसके बजाय सीधे रिटेलर की साइट पर जाएं।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: हॉलिडे ई-कॉमर्स पूर्वानुमान आमतौर पर मौसमी खर्च के एक बड़े और बढ़ते ऑनलाइन हिस्से की ओर इशारा करते हैं, लेकिन वे आपको यह नहीं बता सकते कि कोई विशेष सौदा अच्छा है या नहीं।

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: खरीदारी की वास्तविक लागत उस कीमत पर निर्भर करती है जो आप वास्तव में भुगतान करते हैं, डिलीवरी कितना जोड़ती है, क्या यह समय पर आती है, और यदि आपको इसे वापस भेजने की आवश्यकता है तो क्या होता है।

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: "खरीदें" पर क्लिक करने से पहले इन चारों को देखना साइबर मंडे का अधिकतम लाभ उठाने का सबसे विश्वसनीय तरीका है。

es.title: Cuenta regresiva del Cyber Monday: Lo que dicen las previsiones de gastos navideños sobre ofertas, envíos y devoluciones

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Una vez que concluye el fin de semana del Black Friday, la atención se centra en el día de compras exclusivamente en línea que le sigue: el Cyber Monday.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: Los analistas minoristas llevan tiempo describiéndolo como uno de los días con más actividad del año para el comercio electrónico.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo analiza lo que las previsiones de la industria sugieren generalmente sobre descuentos, costos de envío y plazos de entrega.

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: También aborda por qué una política de devoluciones puede cambiar lo que realmente cuesta una "ganga".

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo ofrece información general, no asesoramiento financiero.

segments.src: Forecast figures vary by source and change over time, so check current reports and each retailer's own terms before you buy.*
segments.tr: Las cifras de las previsiones varían según la fuente y cambian con el tiempo, así que consulta los informes actuales y los términos de cada minorista antes de comprar.*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué el Cyber Monday sigue importando

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: El Cyber Monday comenzó como una forma de lograr que la gente comprara en línea después del fin de semana de Acción de Gracias.

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: Hoy en día, la mayoría de los grandes minoristas lanzan promociones en línea durante días o semanas, por lo que la etiqueta de un solo día se ha difuminado.

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: Los rastreadores de la industria todavía informan a menudo que el gasto en línea en ese día se encuentra entre los más altos del año.

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: Muchos pronosticadores también esperan que las ventas en línea sigan acaparando una mayor parte del comercio minorista navideño total.

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: Dos puntos ayudan a contextualizar las cifras:

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **Las previsiones son estimaciones.** Los grupos comerciales, las firmas de consultoría y las empresas de datos de pagos utilizan diferentes métodos y definiciones de la "temporada navideña". Sus totales y tasas de crecimiento a menudo difieren.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **El crecimiento no es lo mismo que el ahorro.** Una previsión de que el gasto total en línea aumentará dice poco sobre cuán profundo será cualquier descuento individual.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## Qué sugieren las previsiones sobre los descuentos

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: Los analistas que rastrean los precios en línea informan a menudo que las mayores rebajas se concentran en unas pocas categorías, como la electrónica de consumo, los televisores, los pequeños electrodomésticos y algunos juguetes.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: La ropa y los artículos para el hogar también suelen tener descuento, pero los ahorros pueden parecer diferentes de un artículo a otro.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos prácticos:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **Un porcentaje de descuento solo es tan bueno como el precio inicial.** Una etiqueta de "40% de descuento" se puede medir en comparación con un precio de lista al que el artículo rara vez se vendió. Comparar con el precio de venta reciente es más útil.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **El historial de precios ayuda.** Las herramientas de seguimiento de precios y tus propias capturas de pantalla de carritos guardados pueden mostrar si una oferta es nueva o recurrente.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **Las ofertas suelen estar repartidas.** Muchos minoristas ahora lanzan ofertas con anticipación y las repiten. Esperar un día específico puede no darte un mejor precio.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **El stock limitado es común.** Algunas de las rebajas más drásticas se aplican a inventarios pequeños, por lo que un artículo popular puede agotarse sin importar el día.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## Costos de envío y recargos

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: El envío puede eliminar una buena oferta.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: Las previsiones y los anuncios de los minoristas suelen señalar algunos patrones recurrentes:

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **Umbrales de envío gratuito.** Muchas tiendas ofrecen envío estándar gratuito por encima de un valor mínimo de pedido. Es fácil gastar de más para alcanzar el umbral y perder el ahorro.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **Programas de membresía.** Algunos minoristas ofrecen beneficios de envío a través de membresías de pago. Estas pueden valer la pena para compradores frecuentes, pero son una mala opción si solo compras una o dos veces.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **Recargos de las empresas de transporte.** Las empresas de entrega pueden agregar tarifas de temporada alta para el período navideño, y los minoristas pueden trasladar parte de ese costo a los clientes, ya sea abiertamente o mediante precios base más altos.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **Artículos de gran tamaño y direcciones remotas.** Las entregas pesadas, voluminosas o a distancia suelen costar más, y las ofertas de envío gratuito pueden excluirlas.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: Antes de pagar, compara el **costo total de entrega**: precio del artículo, envío, impuestos y cualquier tarifa de gestión.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: Esa es la cifra que debes sopesar frente a una oferta de la competencia.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## Plazos de entrega a tener en cuenta

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: Las fechas límite de los pedidos importan más que el descuento si el artículo es un regalo.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: Los minoristas y las empresas de transporte suelen publicar sus últimas fechas de pedido recomendadas para el envío estándar a mediados de diciembre, con fechas posteriores para las opciones exprés de pago.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: Estas fechas varían según la empresa y la región.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: Algunos consejos:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **Lee la estimación de entrega al finalizar la compra,** no solo en la página del producto. La fecha de llegada prometida a menudo depende de tu dirección y del nivel de envío.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **Comprueba si las fechas de "llega el" están garantizadas.** Algunos minoristas ofrecen un compromiso firme y otros solo dan una estimación.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **Considera la recogida en tienda.** Cuando esté disponible, comprar en línea y recoger en la tienda puede evitar tarifas de envío y retrasos de la empresa de transporte.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **Conserva los números de seguimiento.** Si un paquete llega tarde o se pierde, el registro del pedido facilita la solicitud de un reemplazo o reembolso.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **Envíos divididos.** Un solo pedido puede llegar en varios paquetes en diferentes fechas. Si necesitas todo para un día determinado, verifica la estimación de cada artículo.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## Devoluciones: la mitad oculta del precio

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: Un descuento vale menos si el artículo es difícil de devolver.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: Las reglas de devolución a menudo se vuelven más estrictas en el período navideño en algunos aspectos y más generosas en otros, así que léeselas antes de comprar.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: Aspectos clave a comprobar:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **El plazo de devolución.** Algunos minoristas extienden su período de devolución navideño hasta enero. Otros mantienen el plazo habitual, que puede ser de solo unas pocas semanas.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **Quién paga el envío de devolución.** Las devoluciones gratuitas son comunes en algunas tiendas, mientras que otras deducen una tarifa o exigen que pagues a la empresa de transporte.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **Tarifas de reposición de existencias.** Ciertas categorías, especialmente la electrónica, pueden conllevar un cargo porcentual si se abre el artículo.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **Artículos de venta final.** Los productos con grandes descuentos o de liquidación a veces no se pueden devolver en absoluto.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **Método de reembolso.** Algunas tiendas reembolsan al método de pago original y otras solo ofrecen crédito en la tienda o un cambio en ciertos casos.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **Reglas de condición.** A menudo se requieren el embalaje original, las etiquetas y los accesorios. Consérvalos hasta que estés seguro de que te vas a quedar con el artículo.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: Una forma sencilla de pensarlo: si un artículo de $100 tiene un 30% de descuento pero cuesta $12 devolverlo y conlleva una tarifa de reposición del 15%, el costo real de una compra equivocada es mucho mayor de lo que sugiere el precio de etiqueta.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: Un artículo ligeramente más caro de un vendedor con devoluciones gratuitas y fáciles puede ser de mejor valor.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## Una breve lista de verificación previa al pago

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. Decide tu presupuesto y una lista de necesidades antes de navegar.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. Compara el historial de precios reciente, no solo el precio "anterior".

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. Suma el costo total: precio, envío, impuestos y tarifas.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. Confirma la fecha de entrega para tu dirección y la opción de envío que elegiste.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. Lee el plazo de devolución, el costo de envío de la devolución y cualquier tarifa de reposición.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. Paga con un método que ofrezca protección de compra y conserva tus recibos y correos electrónicos de confirmación.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. Ten cuidado con los vendedores desconocidos y con los enlaces en mensajes no solicitados. En su lugar, ve directamente al sitio del minorista.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: Las previsiones de comercio electrónico para las fiestas generalmente apuntan a una participación en línea grande y creciente del gasto estacional, pero no pueden decirte si una oferta en particular es buena.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: El costo real de una compra depende del precio que realmente pagues, de cuánto agrega el envío, de si llega a tiempo y de lo que sucede si necesitas devolverlo.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Analizar los cuatro aspectos antes de hacer clic en "comprar" es la forma más fiable de aprovechar al máximo el Cyber Monday.

ar.title: العد التنازلي لـ Cyber Monday: ما تقوله توقعات إنفاق العطلات حول الصفقات والتوصيل والمرتجعات

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: بمجرد انتهاء عطلة نهاية الأسبوع الخاصة بـ Black Friday، يتحول الاهتمام إلى يوم التسوق عبر الإنترنت فقط الذي يليه: Cyber Monday.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: لطالما وصفه محللو التجزئة بأنه أحد أكثر أيام السنة ازدحاماً للتجارة الإلكترونية.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: يلقي هذا الشرح نظرة على ما تشير إليه توقعات الصناعة بشكل عام حول الخصومات وتكاليف الشحن ومواعيد التسليم النهائية.

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: كما يغطي أيضاً سبب قدرة سياسة الإرجاع على تغيير التكلفة الحقيقية لـ "الصفقة".

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة عبارة عن معلومات عامة، وليست نصيحة مالية.

segments.src: Forecast figures vary by source and change over time, so check current reports and each retailer's own terms before you buy.*
segments.tr: تختلف أرقام التوقعات حسب المصدر وتتغير بمرور الوقت، لذا تحقق من التقارير الحالية وشروط كل بائع تجزئة قبل الشراء.*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يزال Cyber Monday مهماً

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: بدأ Cyber Monday كوسيلة لجذب الناس للتسوق عبر الإنترنت بعد عطلة نهاية أسبوع عيد الشكر.

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: اليوم، يدير معظم كبار تجار التجزئة عروضاً ترويجية عبر الإنترنت لأيام أو أسابيع، لذا تلاشت حدود التسمية التي تشير إلى يوم واحد.

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: لا يزال مراقبو الصناعة غالباً ما يذكرون أن الإنفاق عبر الإنترنت في ذلك اليوم هو من بين الأعلى في السنة.

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: كما يتوقع العديد من المتنبئين أن تستمر المبيعات عبر الإنترنت في الاستحواذ على حصة أكبر من إجمالي مبيعات التجزئة في العطلات.

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: تساعد نقطتان في وضع الأرقام في سياقها:

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **التوقعات هي تقديرات.** تستخدم المجموعات التجارية وشركات الاستشارات وشركات بيانات الدفع طرقاً وتعريفات مختلفة لـ "موسم العطلات". غالباً ما تختلف إجمالياتها ومعدلات نموها.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **النمو لا يعني التوفير.** التوقعات بأن إجمالي الإنفاق عبر الإنترنت سيرتفع لا تقول الكثير عن مدى عمق أي خصم فردي.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## ما تشير إليه التوقعات حول الخصومات

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يذكر المحللون الذين يتتبعون الأسعار عبر الإنترنت أن أكبر التخفيضات تتركز في بضع فئات، مثل الإلكترونيات الاستهلاكية وأجهزة التلفزيون والأجهزة المنزلية الصغيرة وبعض الألعاب.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: عادة ما يتم خصم الملابس والسلع المنزلية أيضاً، لكن التوفير قد يبدو مختلفاً من عنصر لآخر.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **سجل الأسعار يساعد.** يمكن لأدوات تتبع الأسعار ولقطات شاشة عربة التسوق المحفوظة الخاصة بك أن تظهر ما إذا كانت الصفقة جديدة أم متكررة.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **المخزون المحدود أمر شائع.** تنطبق بعض أكبر التخفيضات على مخزونات صغيرة، لذا قد ينفد عنصر شائع بغض النظر عن اليوم.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: أشياء رئيسية يجب التحقق منها:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **نافذة الإرجاع.** يمدد بعض تجار التجزئة فترة إرجاع العطلات الخاصة بهم حتى يناير. يحتفظ آخرون بالنافذة المعتادة، والتي قد تكون بضعة أسابيع فقط.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **من يدفع مقابل شحن الإرجاع.** الإرجاع المجاني شائع في بعض المتاجر، بينما يخصم آخرون رسوماً أو يطلبون منك الدفع لشركة النقل.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **رسوم إعادة التخزين.** قد تحمل فئات معينة، خاصة الإلكترونيات، رسوماً بنسبة مئوية إذا تم فتح العنصر.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **عناصر البيع النهائي.** السلع المخفضة بشدة أو سلع التصفية أحياناً لا يمكن إرجاعها على الإطلاق.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **طريقة الاسترداد.** ترد بعض المتاجر الأموال إلى طريقة الدفع الأصلية، ويقدم آخرون رصيد متجر أو استبدالاً في حالات معينة فقط.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **قواعد الحالة.** غالباً ما تكون العبوة الأصلية والملصقات والملحقات مطلوبة. احتفظ بها حتى تتأكد من أنك ستحتفظ بالعنصر.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: طريقة بسيطة للتفكير في الأمر: إذا كان عنصر بقيمة 100 دولار بخصم 30% ولكنه يكلف 12 دولاراً للإرجاع ويحمل رسوم إعادة تخزين بنسبة 15%، فإن التكلفة الحقيقية لعملية شراء خاطئة أعلى بكثير مما يشير إليه سعر الملصق.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: قد يكون العنصر الأغلى قليلاً من بائع لديه إرجاع مجاني وسهل هو القيمة الأفضل.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## قائمة مراجعة قصيرة قبل الدفع

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. حدد ميزانيتك وقائمة احتياجاتك قبل التصفح.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. قارن سجل الأسعار الأخير، وليس فقط السعر "السابق".

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. اجمع التكلفة الكاملة: السعر، الشحن، الضريبة والرسوم.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. أكد تاريخ التسليم لعنوانك وخيار الشحن الذي اخترته.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. اقرأ نافذة الإرجاع، وتكلفة شحن الإرجاع وأي رسوم إعادة تخزين.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. ادفع بطريقة توفر حماية الشراء، واحتفظ بإيصالاتك ورسائل التأكيد الإلكترونية.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. كن حذراً مع البائعين غير المعروفين ومع الروابط في الرسائل غير المرغوب فيها. انتقل إلى موقع بائع التجزئة مباشرة بدلاً من ذلك.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة
