fr.title: Compte à rebours du Cyber Monday : ce que les prévisions de dépenses de fin d'année disent sur les promotions, la livraison et les retours

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Une fois le week-end du Black Friday terminé, l'attention se tourne vers la journée de shopping exclusivement en ligne qui le suit : le Cyber Monday.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: Les analystes du secteur de la distribution le décrivent depuis longtemps comme l'un des jours les plus chargés de l'année pour le commerce électronique.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: Cet article explicatif examine ce que les prévisions du secteur suggèrent généralement concernant les réductions, les frais d'expédition et les délais de livraison.

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: Il explique également pourquoi une politique de retour peut modifier le coût réel d'une « affaire ».

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article constitue une information générale et non un conseil financier.

segments.src: Forecast figures vary by source and change over time, so check current reports and each retailer's own terms before you buy.*
segments.tr: Les chiffres prévisionnels varient selon les sources et évoluent au fil du temps, vérifiez donc les rapports récents et les conditions propres à chaque commerçant avant d'acheter.*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le Cyber Monday a toujours de l'importance

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: Le Cyber Monday a commencé comme un moyen d'inciter les gens à acheter en ligne après le week-end de Thanksgiving.

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: Aujourd'hui, la plupart des grands détaillants proposent des promotions en ligne pendant des jours ou des semaines, de sorte que la notion de journée unique s'est floutée.

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: Les spécialistes du suivi du secteur indiquent toujours souvent que les dépenses en ligne lors de cette journée figurent parmi les plus élevées de l'année.

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: De nombreux prévisionnistes s'attendent également à ce que les ventes en ligne continuent de prendre une part croissante dans l'ensemble du commerce de détail des fêtes.

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: Deux points aident à remettre ces chiffres en contexte :

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **Les prévisions sont des estimations.** Les groupements professionnels, les cabinets de conseil et les sociétés de données de paiement utilisent des méthodes et des définitions différentes de la « période des fêtes ». Leurs totaux et leurs taux de croissance diffèrent souvent.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **La croissance n'est pas synonyme d'économies.** Une prévision indiquant que les dépenses globales en ligne vont augmenter ne dit pas grand-chose sur l'importance d'une réduction individuelle.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## Ce que les prévisions suggèrent concernant les réductions

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent les prix en ligne rapportent souvent que les remises les plus importantes se concentrent dans quelques catégories, telles que l'électronique grand public, les téléviseurs, le petit électroménager et certains jouets.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: L'habillement et les articles pour la maison font généralement aussi l'objet de réductions, mais les économies réalisées peuvent varier fortement d'un article à l'autre.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: Quelques points pratiques :

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **Un pourcentage de remise ne vaut que par rapport au prix de départ.** Une mention « -40 % » peut être calculée par rapport à un prix catalogue auquel l'article n'a presque jamais été vendu. Comparer avec le prix de vente récent est plus utile.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **L'historique des prix aide.** Les outils de suivi des prix et vos propres captures d'écran de panier enregistré permettent de savoir si une offre est nouvelle ou récurrente.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **Les offres sont souvent étalées.** De nombreux commerçants lancent désormais des offres tôt et les répètent. Attendre une journée spécifique ne garantit pas d'obtenir un meilleur prix.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **Les stocks limités sont fréquents.** Certaines des réductions les plus fortes s'appliquent à de petits stocks, de sorte qu'un article populaire peut être épuisé quelle que soit la journée.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## Frais d'expédition et suppléments

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: Les frais de port peuvent annuler une bonne affaire.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: Les prévisions et les annonces des commerçants mettent souvent en évidence quelques schémas récurrents :

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **Seuils pour la livraison gratuite.** De nombreux magasins offrent la livraison standard gratuite au-delà d'un montant d'achat minimum. Il est facile de dépenser plus pour atteindre ce seuil et de perdre l'économie réalisée.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **Programmes d'abonnement.** Certains détaillants proposent des avantages de livraison via des abonnements payants. Ils peuvent être rentables pour les acheteurs fréquents, mais s'avèrent peu adaptés si vous n'achetez qu'une ou deux fois.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **Surcharges des transporteurs.** Les entreprises de livraison peuvent ajouter des frais de haute saison pour la période des fêtes, et les détaillants peuvent répercuter une partie de ce coût sur les clients, de manière transparente ou via des prix de base plus élevés.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **Articles volumineux et adresses isolées.** Les livraisons lourdes, encombrantes ou vers des zones éloignées coûtent souvent plus cher, et les offres de livraison gratuite peuvent les exclure.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: Avant de valider votre commande, comparez le **coût total rendu** : prix de l'article, livraison, taxes et éventuels frais de manutention.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: C'est ce chiffre qu'il faut mettre en balance avec une offre concurrente.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## Délais de livraison à surveiller

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: Les dates limites de commande comptent plus que la réduction si l'article est un cadeau.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: Les commerçants et les transporteurs publient généralement leurs dernières dates de commande recommandées pour une livraison standard vers la mi-décembre, avec des dates plus tardives pour les options express payantes.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: Ces dates varient selon l'entreprise et la région.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: Quelques conseils :

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **Lisez l'estimation de livraison lors du paiement,** et pas seulement sur la page du produit. La date d'arrivée promise dépend souvent de votre adresse et du mode d'expédition choisie.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez si les dates « arrive le » sont garanties.** Certains détaillants prennent un engagement ferme, tandis que d'autres ne donnent qu'une estimation.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **Pensez au retrait en magasin.** Lorsque cela est possible, acheter en ligne et retirer en magasin permet d'éviter les frais d'expédition et les retards de transport.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **Conservez les numéros de suivi.** Si un colis est en retard ou perdu, l'historique de la commande facilite la demande de remplacement ou de remboursement.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **Envois fractionnés.** Une seule commande peut arriver en plusieurs colis à des dates différentes. Si vous avez besoin de tout pour un jour précis, vérifiez l'estimation de chaque article.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## Les retours : la face cachée du prix

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: Une réduction a moins de valeur s'il est difficile de renvoyer l'article.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: Les règles de retour deviennent souvent plus strictes par certains côtés et plus généreuses par d'autres pendant la période des fêtes, lisez-les donc avant d'acheter.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: Points clés à vérifier :

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **Le délai de retour.** Certains commerçants prolongent leur période de retour des fêtes jusqu'en janvier. D'autres conservent leur délai habituel, qui peut n'être que de quelques semaines.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **Qui paie les frais de retour.** Les retours gratuits sont fréquents dans certains magasins, tandis que d'autres déduisent des frais ou vous obligent à payer le transporteur.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **Frais de remise en stock.** Certaines catégories, notamment l'électronique, peuvent appliquer des frais en pourcentage si l'article est ouvert.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **Articles en vente finale.** Les articles fortement remisés ou en liquidation ne sont parfois pas du tout reprenables.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **Mode de remboursement.** Certains magasins remboursent sur le mode de paiement d'origine, tandis que d'autres n'offrent qu'un avoir ou un échange dans certains cas.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **Conditions relatives à l'état.** L'emballage d'origine, les étiquettes et les accessoires sont souvent exigés. Conservez-les jusqu'à ce que vous soyez sûr de garder l'article.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: Une façon simple d'y penser : si un article à 100 $ bénéficie de 30 % de réduction mais coûte 12 $ à renvoyer et implique 15 % de frais de remise en stock, le coût réel d'un achat erroné est bien plus élevé que ne le suggère l'étiquette.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: Un article légèrement plus cher auprès d'un vendeur proposant des retours gratuits et faciles peut s'avérer plus avantageux.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## Une courte liste de contrôle avant de payer

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. Définissez votre budget et une liste de besoins avant de parcourir les offres.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. Comparez l'historique récent des prix, pas seulement le prix « d'origine ».

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. Calculez le coût total : prix, livraison, taxes et frais.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. Confirmez la date de livraison pour votre adresse et l'option d'expédition choisie.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. Lisez le délai de retour, le coût de l'expédition de retour et les éventuels frais de remise en stock.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. Payez avec un moyen de paiement offrant une protection des achats, et conservez vos reçus et e-mails de confirmation.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. Soyez prudent avec les vendeurs inconnus et les liens contenus dans des messages non sollicités. Allez plutôt directement sur le site du commerçant.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: Les prévisions du commerce électronique pour les fêtes indiquent généralement une part en ligne importante et croissante dans les dépenses saisonnières, mais elles ne peuvent pas vous dire si une offre particulière est intéressante.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: Le coût réel d'un achat dépend du prix que vous payez réellement, du montant ajouté par la livraison, de l'arrivée dans les temps et de ce qui se passe si vous devez le renvoyer.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Examiner ces quatre éléments avant de cliquer sur « acheter » est le moyen le plus fiable de tirer le meilleur parti du Cyber Monday.

segments.tr: - **Previsões são estimativas.** Grupos comerciais, empresas de consultoria e empresas de dados de pagamento usam métodos e definições diferentes de "temporada de festas". Seus totais e taxas de crescimento costumam diferir.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **Crescimento não é o mesmo que economia.** Uma previsão de que os gastos online totais aumentarão diz pouco sobre o quão profundo será um desconto individual.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## O que as previsões sugerem sobre descontos

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: Analistas que acompanham os preços online costumam relatar que os maiores descontos se concentram em algumas categorias, como eletrônicos de consumo, televisores, eletrodomésticos portáteis e alguns brinquedos.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: Roupas e artigos para a casa geralmente também recebem descontos, mas a economia pode variar bastante de item para item.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos práticos:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **Um percentual de desconto só é bom dependendo do preço inicial.** Um rótulo de "40% de desconto" pode ser calculado em relação a um preço de tabela pelo qual o item raramente foi vendido. Comparar com o preço de venda recente é mais útil.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **O histórico de preços ajuda.** Ferramentas de rastreamento de preços e suas próprias capturas de tela do carrinho salvo podem mostrar se uma oferta é nova ou recorrente.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **As ofertas costumam ser distribuídas.** Muitos varejistas agora lançam ofertas com antecedência e as repetem. Esperar por um dia específico pode não garantir um preço melhor.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **Estoque limitado é comum.** Alguns dos descontos mais agressivos se aplicam a estoques pequenos, portanto, um item popular pode se esgotar independentemente do dia.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## Custos de frete e sobretaxas

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: O frete pode anular uma boa oferta.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: Previsões e anúncios de varejistas costumam apontar para alguns padrões recorrentes:

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **Limites para frete grátis.** Muitas lojas oferecem frete padrão gratuito acima de um valor mínimo de pedido. É fácil gastar mais apenas para atingir o limite e perder a economia.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **Programas de assinatura.** Alguns varejistas oferecem benefícios de frete por meio de assinaturas pagas. Elas podem valer a pena para compradores frequentes, mas não são indicadas se você compra apenas uma ou duas vezes.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **Sobretaxas de transportadoras.** Empresas de entrega podem adicionar taxas de alta temporada para o período de festas, e os varejistas podem repassar parte desse custo para os clientes, seja abertamente ou por meio de preços base mais altos.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **Itens de grande porte e endereços remotos.** Entregas pesadas, volumosas ou para locais distantes costumam custar mais, e as ofertas de frete grátis podem excluí-las.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: Antes de finalizar a compra, compare o **custo total final**: preço do item, frete, impostos e quaisquer taxas de manuseio.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: Esse é o valor a ser ponderado em comparação com uma oferta concorrente.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## Prazos de entrega para ficar de olho

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: Os limites de data para pedido importam mais do que o desconto se o item for um presente.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: Varejistas e transportadoras costumam publicar suas últimas datas recomendadas de pedido para entrega padrão meados de dezembro, com datas posteriores para opções expressas pagas.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: Essas datas diferem por empresa e por região.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: Algumas dicas:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **Leia a estimativa de entrega na finalização da compra,** não apenas na página do produto. A data de chegada prometida frequentemente depende do seu endereço e do tipo de frete.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **Verifique se as datas de "chega até" são garantidas.** Alguns varejistas assumem um compromisso firme, enquanto outros fornecem apenas uma estimativa.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **Considere a retirada na loja.** Quando disponível, comprar online e retirar na loja pode evitar taxas de frete e atrasos na entrega.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **Guarde os códigos de rastreamento.** Se um pacote atrasar ou se perder, o registro do pedido facilita a solicitação de substituição ou reembolso.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **Envios fracionados.** Um único pedido pode chegar em vários pacotes em datas diferentes. Se você precisar de tudo até um determinado dia, verifique a estimativa de cada item.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## Devoluções: a metade oculta do preço

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: Um desconto vale menos se o item for difícil de devolver.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: As regras de devolução costumam ficar mais rígidas no período de festas em alguns aspectos e mais generosas em outros, portanto, leia-as antes de comprar.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: Principais pontos a verificar:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **O prazo de devolução.** Alguns varejistas estendem seu período de devolução de fim de ano até janeiro. Outros mantêm o prazo habitual, que pode ser de apenas algumas semanas.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **Quem paga pelo frete de devolução.** Devoluções gratuitas são comuns em algumas lojas, enquanto outras deduzem uma taxa ou exigem que você pague a transportadora.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **Taxas de reestocagem.** Certas categorias, especialmente eletrônicos, podem cobrar uma porcentagem se o item for aberto.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **Itens em venda final.** Produtos com grandes descontos ou de liquidação às vezes não podem ser devolvidos de forma alguma.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **Método de reembolso.** Algumas lojas reembolsam no método de pagamento original, e outras oferecem apenas crédito na loja ou troca em certos casos.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **Regras sobre a condição do produto.** Embalagem original, etiquetas e acessórios costumam ser exigidos. Guarde-os até ter certeza de que vai ficar com o item.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: Uma maneira simples de pensar sobre isso: se um item de $100 tem 30% de desconto, mas custa $12 para devolver e cobra uma taxa de reestocagem de 15%, o custo real de uma compra equivocada é muito maior do que o preço da etiqueta sugere.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: Um item ligeiramente mais caro de um vendedor com devoluções gratuitas e fáceis pode ser a melhor opção.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## Um breve checklist antes de finalizar a compra

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. Defina seu orçamento e uma lista de necessidades antes de navegar.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. Compare o histórico recente de preços, não apenas o preço "de".

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. Somes todos os custos: preço, frete, impostos e taxas.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. Confirme a data de entrega para o seu endereço e a opção de frete escolhida.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. Leia o prazo de devolução, o custo do frete de devolução e qualquer taxa de reestocagem.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. Pague com um método que ofereça proteção ao comprador e guarde seus recibos e e-mails de confirmação.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. Seja cauteloso com vendedores desconhecidos e links em mensagens não solicitadas. Em vez disso, acesse o site do varejista diretamente.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: As previsões de e-commerce para as festas geralmente apontam para uma participação online grande e crescente nos gastos sazonais, mas não podem dizer se uma oferta específica é boa.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: O custo real de uma compra depende do preço que você realmente paga, de quanto o frete adiciona, se ela chega a tempo e do que acontece se você precisar devolvê-la.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Analisar esses quatro pontos antes de clicar em "comprar" é a maneira mais confiável de aproveitar ao máximo a Cyber Monday.

in.title: Hitung Mundur Cyber Monday: Apa Kata Prakiraan Belanja Liburan Tentang Diskon, Pengiriman, dan Pengembalian

segments.tr: Setelah akhir pekan Black Friday berakhir, perhatian beralih ke hari belanja khusus daring yang mengikutinya: Cyber Monday.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: Analis ritel telah lama menggambarkannya sebagai salah satu hari tersibuk dalam setahun untuk e-commerce.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini melihat apa yang umumnya disarankan oleh prakiraan industri mengenai diskon, biaya pengiriman, dan tenggat waktu pengiriman.

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: Ini juga membahas mengapa kebijakan pengembalian barang dapat mengubah apa yang sebenarnya disebut sebagai "penawaran menarik".

segments.tr: Angka prakiraan bervariasi menurut sumber dan berubah seiring waktu, jadi periksa laporan terkini dan ketentuan masing-masing peritel sebelum Anda membeli.*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Cyber Monday masih penting

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: Cyber Monday dimulai sebagai cara untuk membuat orang berbelanja daring setelah akhir pekan Thanksgiving.

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: Saat ini, sebagian besar peritel besar menjalankan promosi daring selama berhari-hari atau berminggu-minggu, sehingga label satu hari tersebut telah kabur.

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: Pelacak industri masih sering melaporkan bahwa pengeluaran daring pada hari tersebut termasuk yang tertinggi sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: Banyak peramal juga memperkirakan penjualan daring akan terus mengambil porsi yang lebih besar dari total ritel liburan.

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: Dua poin membantu menempatkan angka-angka tersebut dalam konteks:

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **Prakiraan adalah estimasi.** Kelompok perdagangan, firma konsultan, dan perusahaan data pembayaran menggunakan metode dan definisi yang berbeda tentang "musim liburan". Total dan tingkat pertumbuhan mereka sering kali berbeda.

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **Pertumbuhan tidak sama dengan penghematan.** Prakiraan bahwa total pengeluaran daring akan meningkat tidak banyak bicara tentang seberapa besar diskon tunggal yang akan diberikan.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## Apa yang disarankan prakiraan tentang diskon

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: Analis yang melacak harga daring sering melaporkan bahwa potongan harga terbesar terkumpul dalam beberapa kategori, seperti elektronik konsumen, televisi, peralatan rumah tangga kecil, dan beberapa mainan.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: Pakaian dan barang kebutuhan rumah tangga biasanya juga didiskon, tetapi penghematannya bisa terlihat berbeda dari satu barang ke barang lainnya.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: Beberapa poin praktis:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **Persentase diskon hanya sebaik harga awalnya.** Label "diskon 40%" dapat diukur terhadap harga daftar yang jarang dijual untuk barang tersebut. Membandingkan dengan harga jual terkini lebih berguna.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **Riwayat harga membantu.** Alat pelacak harga dan tangkapan layar keranjang belanja Anda sendiri dapat menunjukkan apakah suatu penawaran itu baru atau berulang.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **Penawaran sering kali disebar.** Banyak peritel sekarang merilis penawaran lebih awal dan mengulanginya. Menunggu satu hari tertentu mungkin tidak memberikan harga yang lebih baik.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **Stok terbatas adalah hal yang umum.** Beberapa potongan harga paling tajam berlaku untuk inventaris kecil, jadi barang populer mungkin terjual habis kapan pun harinya.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## Biaya pengiriman dan biaya tambahan

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: Pengiriman bisa menghapus penawaran yang bagus.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: Prakiraan dan pengumuman peritel sering kali menunjukkan beberapa pola yang berulang:

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **Ambang batas pengiriman gratis.** Banyak toko menawarkan pengiriman standar gratis di atas nilai pesanan minimum. Sangat mudah untuk membelanjakan uang ekstra demi mencapai ambang batas tersebut dan kehilangan penghematannya.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **Program keanggotaan.** Beberapa peritel menawarkan manfaat pengiriman melalui keanggotaan berbayar. Ini bisa menguntungkan bagi pembeli yang sering berbelanja, tetapi kurang cocok jika Anda hanya membeli sekali atau dua kali.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **Biaya tambahan kurir.** Perusahaan pengiriman mungkin menambahkan biaya musim puncak untuk periode liburan, dan peritel mungkin membebankan sebagian biaya tersebut kepada pelanggan, baik secara terbuka maupun melalui harga dasar yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **Barang berukuran besar dan alamat terpencil.** Pengiriman barang berat, besar, atau ke tempat jauh sering kali memakan biaya lebih, dan penawaran pengiriman gratis mungkin mengecualikannya.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: Sebelum Anda membayar, bandingkan **total biaya akhir**: harga barang, pengiriman, pajak, dan biaya penanganan apa pun.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: Itulah angka yang harus dipertimbangkan terhadap penawaran pesaing.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## Tenggat waktu pengiriman yang perlu diperhatikan

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: Batas waktu pemesanan lebih penting daripada diskon jika barang tersebut adalah hadiah.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: Peritel dan kurir biasanya memublikasikan tanggal pemesanan terakhir yang disarankan untuk pengiriman standar pada pertengahan Desember, dengan tanggal yang lebih lambat untuk opsi ekspedisi berbayar.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: Tanggal-tanggal ini berbeda menurut perusahaan dan wilayah.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: Beberapa tips:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **Baca estimasi pengiriman saat pembayaran,** bukan hanya di halaman produk. Tanggal kedatangan yang dijanjikan sering kali bergantung pada alamat Anda dan tingkat pengiriman.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **Periksa apakah tanggal "tiba pada" dijamin.** Beberapa peritel memberikan komitmen tegas, dan yang lain hanya memberikan estimasi.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan pengambilan di toko.** Jika tersedia, membeli secara daring dan mengambil di toko dapat menghindari biaya pengiriman dan keterlambatan kurir.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **Simpan nomor pelacakan.** Jika paket terlambat atau hilang, catatan pesanan memudahkan untuk meminta penggantian atau pengembalian dana.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **Pengiriman terpisah.** Satu pesanan mungkin tiba dalam beberapa paket pada tanggal yang berbeda. Jika Anda membutuhkan semuanya pada hari tertentu, periksa estimasi setiap barang.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## Pengembalian: separuh harga yang tersembunyi

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: Diskon tidak ada artinya jika barang sulit untuk dikembalikan.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: Aturan pengembalian sering kali menjadi lebih ketat selama periode liburan dalam beberapa hal dan lebih longgar dalam hal lain, jadi bacalah aturan tersebut sebelum Anda membeli.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: Hal-hal utama untuk diperiksa:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **Jendela pengembalian.** Beberapa peritel memperpanjang periode pengembalian liburan mereka hingga Januari. Yang lain tetap menggunakan jendela biasa, yang mungkin hanya beberapa minggu.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **Siapa yang membayar pengiriman pengembalian.** Pengembalian gratis umum di beberapa toko, sementara yang lain memotong biaya atau mengharuskan Anda membayar kurir.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **Biaya penyetokan ulang.** Kategori tertentu, terutama elektronik, mungkin dikenakan biaya persentase jika barang sudah dibuka.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **Barang obral akhir.** Barang yang didiskon besar-besaran atau barang cuci gudang terkadang tidak dapat dikembalikan sama sekali.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **Metode pengembalian dana.** Beberapa toko mengembalikan dana ke metode pembayaran asli, dan yang lain hanya menawarkan kredit toko atau penukaran dalam kasus tertentu.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **Aturan kondisi.** Kemasan asli, label, dan aksesori sering kali diperlukan. Simpanlah sampai Anda yakin akan menyimpan barang tersebut.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: Cara sederhana untuk memikirkannya: jika barang seharga $100 didiskon 30% tetapi dikenakan biaya $12 untuk pengembalian dan dikenakan biaya penyetokan ulang 15%, biaya sebenarnya dari pembelian yang salah jauh lebih tinggi daripada yang disarankan oleh harga stiker.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: Barang yang sedikit lebih mahal dari penjual dengan pengembalian yang mudah dan gratis mungkin merupakan nilai yang lebih baik.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar periksa singkat sebelum pembayaran

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. Tentukan anggaran dan daftar kebutuhan Anda sebelum menelusuri.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. Bandingkan riwayat harga terkini, bukan hanya harga "sebelumnya".

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. Jumlahkan biaya penuh: harga, pengiriman, pajak, dan biaya tambahan.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. Konfirmasikan tanggal pengiriman untuk alamat Anda dan opsi pengiriman yang Anda pilih.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. Baca jendela pengembalian, biaya pengiriman pengembalian, dan biaya penyetokan ulang apa pun.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. Bayar dengan metode yang menawarkan perlindungan pembelian, dan simpan tanda terima serta email konfirmasi Anda.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. Berhati-hatilah dengan penjual yang tidak dikenal dan dengan tautan dalam pesan yang tidak diminta. Buka situs peritel secara langsung sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: Prakiraan e-commerce liburan umumnya menunjukkan porsi belanja musiman daring yang besar dan terus berkembang, tetapi mereka tidak dapat memberi tahu Anda apakah penawaran tertentu adalah penawaran yang bagus.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: Biaya sebenarnya dari suatu pembelian bergantung pada harga yang Anda bayar, berapa banyak biaya pengiriman yang ditambahkan, apakah barang tiba tepat waktu, dan apa yang terjadi jika Anda perlu mengembalikannya.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Melihat keempat hal tersebut sebelum Anda mengeklik "beli" adalah cara paling andal untuk memanfaatkan Cyber Monday sebaik-baiknya.

ja.title: サイバーマンデーのカウントダウン：ホリデーシーズンの支出予測が示すセール、配送、返品のヒント

segments.src: Once Black Friday weekend wraps up, attention turns to the online-only shopping day that follows it: Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: ブラックフライデーの週末が終わると、その直後に続くオンライン限定のショッピングデー「サイバーマンデー」に注目が集まります。

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: 小売アナリストは長年、この日をEコマースにとって年間で最も忙しい日の一つと表現してきました。

segments.src: This explainer looks at what industry forecasts generally suggest about discounts, shipping costs and delivery deadlines.
segments.tr: この解説記事では、割引、配送料、配送期限について業界予測が一般的に何を示唆しているかを見ていきます。

segments.src: It also covers why a return policy can change what a "bargain" really costs.
segments.tr: また、返品ポリシーが「お買い得品」の真のコストをどのように変え得るかについても取り上げます。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報を提供するものであり、財務上のアドバイスではありません。

segments.tr: 予測数値は情報源によって異なり、時間の経過とともに変化するため、購入前に最新のレポートや各小売業者の利用規約を確認してください。*

segments.src: ## Why Cyber Monday still matters
segments.tr: ## なぜ今もサイバーマンデーが重要なのか

segments.src: Cyber Monday began as a way to get people shopping online after the Thanksgiving weekend.
segments.tr: サイバーマンデーは、感謝祭の週末が終わった後に人々がオンラインで買い物をするための手段として始まりました。

segments.src: Today, most big retailers run online promotions for days or weeks, so the single-day label has blurred.
segments.tr: 今日では、ほとんどの大手小売業者が数日から数週間にわたってオンラインプロモーションを実施しているため、「1日限定」というラベルの意味は薄れています。

segments.src: Industry trackers still often report that online spending on the day is among the highest of the year.
segments.tr: それでも業界の追跡調査では、この日のオンライン支出が年間で最も高い水準にあると報告されることがよくあります。

segments.src: Many forecasters also expect online sales to keep taking a larger share of total holiday retail.
segments.tr: 多くの予測者は、オンライン販売がホリデーシーズンの小売総額に占める割合を今後も拡大し続けると予想しています。

segments.src: Two points help put the numbers in context:
segments.tr: 数字を理解する上で役立つ2つのポイントがあります。

segments.src: - **Forecasts are estimates.** Trade groups, consulting firms and payment-data companies use different methods and definitions of the "holiday season." Their totals and growth rates often differ.
segments.tr: - **予測はあくまで見積もりです。** 業界団体、コンサルティング会社、決済データ企業は、「ホリデーシーズン」に対して異なる手法や定義を使用しています。そのため、合計額や成長率はしばしば異なります。

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **成長は節約と同義ではありません。** オンライン支出総額が増加するという予測は、個々の割引がどれほど大きいかについてはほとんど何も語っていません。

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## 割引について予測が示唆すること

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: オンライン価格を追跡するアナリストは、家電製品、テレビ、小型家電、一部のおもちゃなど、特定のカテゴリーに大幅な値下げが集中する傾向があると報告することがよくあります。

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: アパレルや家庭用品も通常は割引されますが、節約額は商品によって異なる場合があります。

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: いくつかの実践的なポイント：

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **「〇〇%オフ」は元の価格次第です。** 「40%オフ」というラベルは、その商品がめったに売れなかった定価と比較されている可能性があります。最近の販売価格と比較する方がより有益です。

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **価格履歴が役立ちます。** 価格追跡ツールや、自分で保存したカートのスクリーンショットを使えば、そのセールが新しいものか、繰り返されているものかを確認できます。

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **セールは分散されることが多いです。** 多くの小売業者は現在、早期にオファーを公開し、それを繰り返しています。特定の1日を待っても、より良い価格が得られるとは限りません。

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **在庫切れは一般的です。** 最も大幅な値下げの一部は在庫が少ない商品に適用されるため、人気商品は何日であっても売り切れる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## 配送料と追加料金

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: 配送料によって、せっかくのお得な取引が台無しになることがあります。

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: 予測や小売業者の発表では、よくあるパターンがいくつか指摘されています。

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **送料無料のしきい値。** 多くの店舗では、最低注文金額を超えると標準配送が無料になります。しきい値に達するために余分に買い物をしてしまい、節約分を失うのは簡単です。

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **会員プログラム。** 一部の小売業者は、有料会員向けに配送特典を提供しています。頻繁に買い物をする人には元が取れるかもしれませんが、1〜2回しか購入しない場合は適していません。

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **配送業者の追加料金。** 配送会社はホリデー期間中に繁忙期料金を追加する場合があり、小売業者はそのコストの一部を、公然と、あるいは基本価格を引き上げることで顧客に転嫁する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **大型商品や遠隔地への配送。** 重いもの、かさばるもの、遠方への配送はコストがかかることが多く、送料無料の対象外となる場合があります。

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: チェックアウトする前に、**総負担額（トータルランデッドコスト）**を比較してください。商品価格、配送料、税金、手数料などが含まれます。

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: それが、競合するオファーと比較検討すべき数値です。

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## 注意すべき配送期限

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: ギフトの場合、割引よりも注文の締め切りが重要です。

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: 小売業者や配送業者は通常、標準配送の最終推奨注文日を12月中旬に発表し、有料の速達オプションについてはそれより遅い日付を設定します。

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: これらの日付は企業や地域によって異なります。

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: いくつかのヒント：

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **商品ページだけでなく、チェックアウト時の配送予定日を確認してください。** 約束された到着日は、多くの場合、あなたの住所と配送レベルによって異なります。

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **「到着予定日」が保証されているか確認してください。** 確実な約束をする小売業者もあれば、単なる見積もりしか出さない業者もあります。

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **店舗受け取りを検討してください。** 利用可能な場合、オンラインで購入して店舗で受け取ることで、配送料や配送業者の遅延を回避できます。

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **追跡番号を保管してください。** 荷物が遅れたり紛失したりした場合、注文記録があれば交換や返金を依頼しやすくなります。

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **分割配送。** 1回の注文が複数のパッケージに分かれて別々の日に届くことがあります。特定の日にすべてが必要な場合は、各商品の予定日を確認してください。

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## 返品：価格の隠れた半分

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: 返品が困難な場合、割引の価値は下がります。

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: 返品ルールはホリデー期間中に厳しくなる面と寛大になる面があるため、購入前に必ず読んでください。

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: 確認すべき重要な点：

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **返品期間。** 一部の小売業者は、ホリデーシーズンの返品期間を1月まで延長しています。一方で、通常の期間（数週間のみの場合もある）を維持する業者もあります。

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **返品送料の負担。** 一部の店舗では無料返品が一般的ですが、手数料を差し引いたり、配送業者への支払いを顧客に求めたりする店舗もあります。

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **返品手数料（レストッキングフィー）。** 特定のカテゴリー、特に電子機器では、開封済みの場合にパーセンテージで手数料がかかることがあります。

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **最終販売品（ファイナルセール）。** 大幅に割引された商品や在庫処分品は、返品が一切できない場合があります。

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **返金方法。** 元の支払い方法に返金する店舗もあれば、特定のケースではストアクレジットや交換のみを提供する店舗もあります。

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **状態に関するルール。** 元のパッケージ、タグ、付属品が必要な場合がほとんどです。商品を保持すると確信するまで、これらを保管しておいてください。

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: 単純に考えてみましょう。100ドルの商品が30%オフでも、返品に12ドルかかり、15%の返品手数料がかかる場合、間違った購入をした場合の真のコストは、表示価格が示唆するものよりもはるかに高くなります。

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: 無料かつ簡単な返品ができる販売者から少し高めの価格で購入する方が、より価値があるかもしれません。

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## チェックアウト前の短いチェックリスト

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. ブラウジングを始める前に、予算と必要なもののリストを決めましょう。

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. 「以前の価格」だけでなく、最近の価格履歴を比較しましょう。

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. 商品価格、配送料、税金、手数料を含めた総コストを計算しましょう。

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. 自分の住所と選択した配送オプションでの配送日を確認しましょう。

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. 返品期間、返品送料、返品手数料を確認しましょう。

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. 購入保護を提供する支払い方法を使用し、領収書と確認メールを保管しましょう。

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. 不慣れな販売者や、未承諾メッセージ内のリンクには注意してください。代わりに、直接小売業者のサイトにアクセスしましょう。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: ホリデーシーズンのEコマース予測は、一般的に季節支出におけるオンラインシェアが大きく、成長していることを示していますが、特定の取引が良いものかどうかを教えてくれるわけではありません。

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: 購入の真のコストは、実際に支払う価格、配送にかかる追加費用、時間通りに到着するかどうか、そして返品が必要になった場合にどうなるかによって決まります。

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: 「購入」ボタンをクリックする前にこれら4つすべてを確認することが、サイバーマンデーを最大限に活用するための最も確実な方法です。

segments.src: - **Growth is not the same as savings.** A forecast that total online spending will rise says little about how deep any single discount will be.
segments.tr: - **Wachstum ist nicht dasselbe wie Ersparnis.** Eine Prognose, dass die Online-Gesamtausgaben steigen werden, sagt wenig darüber aus, wie hoch ein einzelner Rabatt sein wird.

segments.src: ## What forecasts suggest about discounts
segments.tr: ## Was Prognosen über Rabatte verraten

segments.src: Analysts who track online prices often report that the biggest markdowns cluster in a few categories, such as consumer electronics, televisions, small appliances and some toys.
segments.tr: Analysten, die Online-Preise verfolgen, berichten oft, dass sich die größten Preisnachlässe auf einige wenige Kategorien konzentrieren, wie Unterhaltungselektronik, Fernseher, Kleingeräte und einige Spielwaren.

segments.src: Apparel and home goods are usually discounted too, but the savings can look different from item to item.
segments.tr: Bekleidung und Haushaltswaren werden in der Regel ebenfalls rabattiert, aber die Ersparnis kann von Artikel zu Artikel unterschiedlich ausfallen.

segments.src: Some practical points:
segments.tr: Ein paar praktische Punkte:

segments.src: 1. **A percentage off is only as good as the starting price.** A "40% off" label can be measured against a list price the item rarely sold at. Comparing with the recent selling price is more useful.
segments.tr: 1. **Ein prozentualer Rabatt ist nur so gut wie der Startpreis.** Ein "40% Rabatt"-Etikett kann an einem Listenpreis gemessen werden, zu dem der Artikel selten verkauft wurde. Der Vergleich mit dem kürzlichen Verkaufspreis ist nützlicher.

segments.src: 2. **Price history helps.** Price-tracking tools and your own saved cart screenshots can show whether a deal is new or recurring.
segments.tr: 2. **Preisverlauf hilft.** Preisverfolgungswerkzeuge und Ihre eigenen gespeicherten Warenkorb-Screenshots können zeigen, ob ein Angebot neu ist oder wiederkehrt.

segments.src: 3. **Deals are often spread out.** Many retailers now release offers early and repeat them. Waiting for one specific day may not give you a better price.
segments.tr: 3. **Angebote sind oft gestaffelt.** Viele Händler veröffentlichen Angebote mittlerweile frühzeitig und wiederholen sie. Auf einen bestimmten Tag zu warten, bringt Ihnen möglicherweise keinen besseren Preis.

segments.src: 4. **Limited stock is common.** Some of the steepest markdowns apply to small inventories, so a popular item may sell out whatever the day.
segments.tr: 4. **Begrenzter Lagerbestand ist üblich.** Einige der stärksten Preisnachlässe gelten für kleine Bestände, sodass ein beliebter Artikel unabhängig vom Tag ausverkauft sein kann.

segments.src: ## Shipping costs and surcharges
segments.tr: ## Versandkosten und Zuschläge

segments.src: Shipping can erase a good deal.
segments.tr: Der Versand kann ein gutes Angebot zunichtemachen.

segments.src: Forecasts and retailer announcements often point to a few recurring patterns:
segments.tr: Prognosen und Händlerankündigungen verweisen oft auf einige wiederkehrende Muster:

segments.src: - **Free-shipping thresholds.** Many stores offer free standard shipping above a minimum order value. It is easy to spend extra to reach the threshold and lose the saving.
segments.tr: - **Schwellenwerte für den kostenlosen Versand.** Viele Geschäfte bieten ab einem Mindestbestellwert einen kostenlosen Standardversand an. Es ist leicht, extra auszugeben, um den Schwellenwert zu erreichen und die Ersparnis zu verlieren.

segments.src: - **Membership programs.** Some retailers offer shipping benefits through paid memberships. These can pay off for frequent shoppers, but they are a poor fit if you only buy once or twice.
segments.tr: - **Mitgliedschaftsprogramme.** Einige Händler bieten Versandvorteile durch kostenpflichtige Mitgliedschaften an. Diese können sich für Vielkäufer lohnen, sind aber ungeeignet, wenn Sie nur ein- oder zweimal kaufen.

segments.src: - **Carrier surcharges.** Delivery companies may add peak-season fees for the holiday period, and retailers may pass part of that cost on to customers, either openly or through higher base prices.
segments.tr: - **Versandzuschläge.** Lieferdienste erheben für den Feiertagszeitraum möglicherweise Hochsaisonzusätze, und Händler geben einen Teil dieser Kosten möglicherweise an die Kunden weiter, entweder offen oder durch höhere Basispreise.

segments.src: - **Oversized items and remote addresses.** Heavy, bulky or far-away deliveries often cost more, and free-shipping offers may exclude them.
segments.tr: - **Sperrgut und abgelegene Adressen.** Schwere, sperrige oder weit entfernte Lieferungen kosten oft mehr, und Angebote für kostenlosen Versand schließen diese möglicherweise aus.

segments.src: Before you check out, compare the **total landed cost**: item price, shipping, taxes and any handling fees.
segments.tr: Bevor Sie zur Kasse gehen, vergleichen Sie die **Gesamtkosten**: Artikelpreis, Versand, Steuern und eventuelle Bearbeitungsgebühren.

segments.src: That is the figure to weigh against a competing offer.
segments.tr: Das ist der Betrag, den Sie gegen ein konkurrierendes Angebot abwägen sollten.

segments.src: ## Delivery deadlines to watch
segments.tr: ## Zu beachtende Lieferfristen

segments.src: Order cutoffs matter more than the discount if the item is a gift.
segments.tr: Bestellfristen sind wichtiger als der Rabatt, wenn es sich bei dem Artikel um ein Geschenk handelt.

segments.src: Retailers and carriers usually publish their last recommended order dates for standard delivery in mid-December, with later dates for paid expedited options.
segments.tr: Händler und Frachtführer veröffentlichen ihre letzten empfohlenen Bestelldaten für den Standardversand in der Regel Mitte Dezember, wobei spätere Daten für kostenpflichtige Expressoptionen gelten.

segments.src: These dates differ by company and by region.
segments.tr: Diese Daten unterscheiden sich je nach Unternehmen und Region.

segments.src: Some tips:
segments.tr: Einige Tipps:

segments.src: - **Read the delivery estimate at checkout,** not only on the product page. The promised arrival date often depends on your address and the shipping tier.
segments.tr: - **Lesen Sie die Lieferzeitangabe an der Kasse,** nicht nur auf der Produktseite. Das versprochene Ankunftsdatum hängt oft von Ihrer Adresse und der Versandart ab.

segments.src: - **Check whether "arrives by" dates are guaranteed.** Some retailers give a firm commitment, and others give only an estimate.
segments.tr: - **Prüfen Sie, ob "Lieferung bis"-Daten garantiert sind.** Einige Händler geben eine feste Zusage, während andere nur eine Schätzung abgeben.

segments.src: - **Consider store pickup.** Where available, buying online and collecting in store can avoid shipping fees and carrier delays.
segments.tr: - **Erwägen Sie die Abholung im Geschäft.** Wo verfügbar, können Sie durch Online-Kauf und Abholung im Laden Versandkosten und Verzögerungen beim Transportdienst vermeiden.

segments.src: - **Keep tracking numbers.** If a package is late or lost, the order record makes it easier to ask for a replacement or refund.
segments.tr: - **Bewahren Sie Sendungsnummern auf.** Wenn ein Paket verspätet ist oder verloren geht, erleichtert der Bestelldatensatz die Anforderung von Ersatz oder Erstattung.

segments.src: - **Split shipments.** A single order may arrive in several packages on different dates. If you need everything by a certain day, check each item's estimate.
segments.tr: - **Geteilte Sendungen.** Eine einzige Bestellung kann in mehreren Paketen an verschiedenen Tagen ankommen. Wenn Sie alles bis zu einem bestimmten Tag benötigen, überprüfen Sie die Schätzung jedes Artikels.

segments.src: ## Returns: the hidden half of the price
segments.tr: ## Rücksendungen: die versteckte Hälfte des Preises

segments.src: A discount is worth less if the item is hard to send back.
segments.tr: Ein Rabatt ist weniger wert, wenn der Artikel schwer zurückzuschicken ist.

segments.src: Return rules often become stricter in the holiday period in some ways and more generous in others, so read them before you buy.
segments.tr: Die Rückgabebestimmungen werden im Feiertagszeitraum in mancher Hinsicht strenger und in anderer großzügiger, lesen Sie diese daher vor dem Kauf.

segments.src: Key things to check:
segments.tr: Wichtige Punkte zur Überprüfung:

segments.src: - **The return window.** Some retailers extend their holiday return period into January. Others keep the usual window, which may be only a few weeks.
segments.tr: - **Das Rückgabefenster.** Einige Händler verlängern ihre Rückgabefrist für die Feiertage bis in den Januar hinein. Andere behalten das übliche Zeitfenster bei, das möglicherweise nur wenige Wochen beträgt.

segments.src: - **Who pays for return shipping.** Free returns are common at some stores, while others deduct a fee or require you to pay the carrier.
segments.tr: - **Wer die Rücksendekosten trägt.** Kostenlose Rücksendungen sind in einigen Geschäften üblich, während andere eine Gebühr abziehen oder verlangen, dass Sie den Frachtführer bezahlen.

segments.src: - **Restocking fees.** Certain categories, especially electronics, may carry a percentage charge if the item is opened.
segments.tr: - **Wiedereinlagerungsgebühren.** Bestimmte Kategorien, insbesondere Elektronik, können eine prozentuale Gebühr erheben, wenn der Artikel geöffnet wurde.

segments.src: - **Final-sale items.** Deeply discounted or clearance goods are sometimes not returnable at all.
segments.tr: - **Artikel aus dem Ausverkauf.** Stark rabattierte Waren oder Restposten sind manchmal überhaupt nicht rückgabeberechtigt.

segments.src: - **Refund method.** Some stores refund to the original payment method, and others offer only store credit or an exchange in certain cases.
segments.tr: - **Erstattungsmethode.** Einige Geschäfte erstatten auf die ursprüngliche Zahlungsmethode zurück, während andere in bestimmten Fällen nur Gutscheine oder einen Umtausch anbieten.

segments.src: - **Condition rules.** Original packaging, tags and accessories are often required. Keep them until you are sure you are keeping the item.
segments.tr: - **Zustandsregeln.** Originalverpackung, Etiketten und Zubehör sind oft erforderlich. Bewahren Sie diese auf, bis Sie sicher sind, dass Sie den Artikel behalten.

segments.src: A simple way to think about it: if a $100 item is 30% off but costs $12 to return and carries a 15% restocking fee, the real cost of a mistaken purchase is far higher than the sticker price suggests.
segments.tr: Eine einfache Art, darüber nachzudenken: Wenn ein 100-Dollar-Artikel um 30 % reduziert ist, aber 12 Dollar für die Rücksendung kostet und eine Wiedereinlagerungsgebühr von 15 % anfällt, sind die realen Kosten eines Fehlkaufs viel höher, als das Preisschild vermuten lässt.

segments.src: A slightly pricier item from a seller with free, easy returns may be the better value.
segments.tr: Ein etwas teurerer Artikel von einem Verkäufer mit kostenlosen, einfachen Rücksendungen ist möglicherweise der bessere Wert.

segments.src: ## A short pre-checkout checklist
segments.tr: ## Eine kurze Checkliste vor dem Bezahlen

segments.src: 1. Decide your budget and a list of needs before you browse.
segments.tr: 1. Legen Sie Ihr Budget und eine Liste der benötigten Artikel fest, bevor Sie stöbern.

segments.src: 2. Compare the recent price history, not just the "was" price.
segments.tr: 2. Vergleichen Sie den jüngsten Preisverlauf, nicht nur den "Früher war-Preis".

segments.src: 3. Add up the full cost: price, shipping, tax and fees.
segments.tr: 3. Addieren Sie die Gesamtkosten: Preis, Versand, Steuern und Gebühren.

segments.src: 4. Confirm the delivery date for your address and the shipping option you chose.
segments.tr: 4. Bestätigen Sie das Lieferdatum für Ihre Adresse und die von Ihnen gewählte Versandoption.

segments.src: 5. Read the return window, return shipping cost and any restocking fee.
segments.tr: 5. Lesen Sie das Rückgabefenster, die Rücksendekosten und eventuelle Wiedereinlagerungsgebühren.

segments.src: 6. Pay with a method that offers purchase protection, and keep your receipts and confirmation emails.
segments.tr: 6. Zahlen Sie mit einer Methode, die Käuferschutz bietet, und bewahren Sie Ihre Belege und Bestätigungs-E-Mails auf.

segments.src: 7. Be cautious with unfamiliar sellers and with links in unsolicited messages. Go to the retailer's site directly instead.
segments.tr: 7. Seien Sie vorsichtig bei unbekannten Verkäufern und bei Links in unerwünschten Nachrichten. Gehen Sie stattdessen direkt auf die Website des Händlers.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: Holiday e-commerce forecasts generally point to a large and growing online share of seasonal spending, but they cannot tell you whether a particular deal is a good one.
segments.tr: E-Commerce-Prognosen für die Feiertage deuten im Allgemeinen auf einen großen und wachsenden Online-Anteil an den saisonalen Ausgaben hin, können Ihnen jedoch nicht sagen, ob ein bestimmtes Angebot gut ist.

segments.src: The real cost of a purchase depends on the price you actually pay, how much delivery adds, whether it arrives on time, and what happens if you need to send it back.
segments.tr: Die realen Kosten eines Kaufs hängen von dem Preis ab, den Sie tatsächlich zahlen, wie viel der Versand hinzufügt, ob er pünktlich ankommt und was passiert, wenn Sie ihn zurücksenden müssen.

segments.src: Looking at all four before you click "buy" is the most reliable way to make the most of Cyber Monday.
segments.tr: Alle vier Faktoren vor dem Klick auf "Kaufen" zu betrachten, ist der zuverlässigste Weg, das Beste aus dem Cyber Monday zu machen.

segments.src: Retail analysts have long described it as one of the busiest days of the year for e-commerce.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích bán lẻ từ lâu đã mô tả đây là một trong những ngày bận rộn nhất trong năm đối với thương mại điện tử.
